CERTIFIED TRUE COPY OF THE RESOLUTION PASSED AT THE MEETING OF THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS OF SHREEJI INDUSTRIAL PRODUCTS PRIVATE LIMITED HELD ON FRIDAY, THE 12TH DAY OF JUNE 2026 AT 11:00 A.M. AT THE REGISTERED OFFICE OF THE COMPANY

Present:
1. Mr. Narendra Rameshbhai Patel, Managing Director and Chairman of the meeting (DIN 01234567)
2. Ms. Komal Dineshbhai Shah, Director (DIN 02345678)
3. Mr. Yogesh Mahendrabhai Desai, Director (DIN 03456789)
4. Mrs. Hetal Narendra Patel, Director (DIN 04567890)

The requisite quorum being present, in accordance with Section 174 of the Companies Act, 2013, the Chairman called the meeting to order. Notice of the meeting, along with the agenda, was sent to all the directors on 5 June 2026, in accordance with Section 173(3) of the Companies Act, 2013.

ITEM NO. 4: OPENING OF A CURRENT ACCOUNT AND AUTHORITY TO OPERATE THE BANK ACCOUNT

The Chairman informed the Board that, in view of the expansion of the Company's operations, it was proposed to open a new current account with Narmada Commercial Bank Limited, Alkapuri Branch, Vadodara (the "Bank") for the purpose of the day-to-day business operations of the Company, and to authorise certain directors to operate the account. After discussion, the following resolutions were passed unanimously:

RESOLVED THAT a current account in the name of Shreeji Industrial Products Private Limited be opened with Narmada Commercial Bank Limited, Alkapuri Branch, Vadodara 390007, for the purpose of the Company's business operations, and that the Company accept the Bank's standard terms and conditions for the said account.

RESOLVED FURTHER THAT Mr. Narendra Rameshbhai Patel, Managing Director (DIN 01234567) and Ms. Komal Dineshbhai Shah, Director (DIN 02345678) (together the "Authorised Signatories") be and are hereby authorised to operate the said account, to sign, draw, accept, endorse and issue cheques, drafts, demand drafts, bills of exchange and other negotiable instruments, to give instructions for payments by RTGS, NEFT, IMPS, UPI and net banking (including corporate internet banking), subject to the following limits:

(a) Transactions up to Rs 5,00,000/- (Rupees Five Lakh only) per transaction: any one Authorised Signatory acting singly;

(b) Transactions above Rs 5,00,000/- (Rupees Five Lakh only) and up to Rs 50,00,000/- (Rupees Fifty Lakh only) per transaction: both Authorised Signatories acting jointly;

(c) Transactions above Rs 50,00,000/- (Rupees Fifty Lakh only) per transaction: only with the prior approval of the Board of Directors by a resolution passed at a meeting or by circulation, and signed by both Authorised Signatories jointly;

(d) The aggregate of payments made through the said account on any one day shall not exceed Rs 1,00,00,000/- (Rupees One Crore only), unless otherwise approved by the Board.

RESOLVED FURTHER THAT the Authorised Signatories shall not, under this authority, (i) borrow any money, or open any letter of credit or issue any bank guarantee on behalf of the Company, (ii) create any charge, mortgage, pledge or hypothecation on any asset of the Company, (iii) make any investment or give any loan or guarantee referred to in Section 186 of the Companies Act, 2013, (iv) make any payment to a related party that is not in the ordinary course of business and at arm's length, or (v) withdraw cash in excess of Rs 50,000/- in a day, for each of which the authority of the Board, in accordance with Section 179(3) of the Companies Act, 2013, shall be required.

RESOLVED FURTHER THAT Mr. Yogesh Mahendrabhai Desai, Director (DIN 03456789) be and is hereby authorised to view the account, to download statements and to give instructions for the payment of statutory dues (GST, TDS, PF, ESI and professional tax) in the "maker" capacity on the internet banking, subject to the approval of the Authorised Signatories in the "checker" capacity, and no authority to sign any cheque or to approve any payment is given to him.

RESOLVED FURTHER THAT the Bank be and is hereby authorised to honour all cheques, instruments and instructions issued in accordance with the above limits and to debit the account, and the Bank shall not be bound to enquire into the application of the funds so drawn or into the limits set out in this resolution, which are internal to the Company, other than those communicated in writing to the Bank in the mandate.

RESOLVED FURTHER THAT the specimen signatures of the Authorised Signatories be furnished to the Bank, and the Bank be requested to record the same, and to rely on the same until it receives a written notice from the Company of a change, supported by a certified copy of the resolution of the Board.

RESOLVED FURTHER THAT this authority shall remain in force from 15 June 2026 until it is revoked or modified by a resolution of the Board, and that a copy of the resolution be communicated to the Bank, and any change in the Authorised Signatories shall become effective, vis-a-vis the Bank, only on receipt of a fresh certified true copy of the resolution by the Bank.

RESOLVED FURTHER THAT Mr. Narendra Rameshbhai Patel, Managing Director, or the Company Secretary of the Company, be and is hereby authorised to certify a copy of this resolution as a true copy, to sign and execute the account opening forms, mandate forms, indemnities, and other documents as may be required by the Bank, and to do all such acts, deeds and things as may be necessary to give effect to the above resolutions.

RESOLVED FURTHER THAT the Authorised Signatories shall report to the Board at its next meeting, and thereafter at the end of every quarter, a statement of the receipts and payments made through the said account during the preceding quarter, including every transaction exceeding Rs 5,00,000/- (Rupees Five Lakh only), and the Company's statutory auditor shall be provided with the bank statements and the confirmation of balance as at the end of each financial year.

RESOLVED FURTHER THAT, in the event of the death, resignation, disqualification under Section 164 of the Companies Act, 2013, or incapacity of either Authorised Signatory, the authority of the other Authorised Signatory shall be limited to transactions up to Rs 5,00,000/- (Rupees Five Lakh only) per transaction, and to payments of statutory dues and salaries, until the Board appoints a new Authorised Signatory by a fresh resolution, which shall be passed within thirty (30) days of such event, and the Bank shall be informed in writing within seven (7) days of the event.

RESOLVED FURTHER THAT the existing current account of the Company with State-level Co-operative Bank at Makarpura Branch, Vadodara, shall continue to be operated as per the existing mandate, and that the new account shall be used for payments to suppliers, salary, statutory dues and the receipts from customers, with effect from 1 July 2026.

There being no other business, the meeting concluded at 12:30 p.m. with a vote of thanks to the Chair.
